title: Uniqueness of a compatible local component leg
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, K a field and χ:κ_R(p) → K a field map [def-weil-residue-field]. Put A=R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let q in Spec A and ψ:κ_A(q) → K have evaluation equal to a specified A-algebra map, whose restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Given a ring V, a cocone η on the global pointed etale triples, and a local triple t, any two ring maps b,b′:t.B → V satisfying β followed by b = η_s and β followed by b′ = η_s for every global triple s and every ring map β:s.B → t.B commuting with the R-structure and pointings to K are equal. No existence of such a map is asserted.

source.place: Tags 00CR, 01ZM, 07RP, 01Z6 and 04GW; localization and affine finite-presentation descent argument

proof.text: Use the auxiliary descent lemma to obtain a global triple s and an epimorphic pointed map β : s.B → t.B. Apply hb and hb' to β, then cancel the epimorphism β.

theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_component_extension_unique
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    (hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    (V : CommRingCat.{u})
    (η : etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj V)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ)
    (b b' : t.B ⟶ V)
    (hb : ∀ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (β : s.B ⟶ t.B),
        s.α ≫ β = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
          t.α →
        β ≫ (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ =
          (ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ →
        β ≫ b = η.app s)
    (hb' : ∀ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (β : s.B ⟶ t.B),
        s.α ≫ β = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
          t.α →
        β ≫ (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ =
          (ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ →
        β ≫ b' = η.app s) :
    b = b'
